configurations.name: FlowPulse: 포트 정리 후 실행
configurations.command: test -f /usr/local/var/postgresql@17/PG_VERSION || brew postinstall postgresql@17; brew services start postgresql@17 >/dev/null; sleep 2; /usr/local/opt/postgresql@17/bin/createdb flowpulse 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -tiTCP:5174 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -tiTCP:8789 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; npm run dev
